title: Visit to Seville

title: Highly recommended

title: Another great day, private transfer...
text: Another great day, private transfer from Granada to Seville, then we were the only ones on the tour. well worth the 2.5hr journey to see this. Tour lasted around 2.5hrs then we had free time for lunch, more sightseeing on our own

title: The ride from Granada to Seville is...
text: The ride from Granada to Seville is about 3 hours long. The bus was comfortable and our driver was very nice, but got a bit lost when we arrived in Seville...we should have arrived around 11am and instead did not arrive at the start of the tour until nearly 12pm. We had expected on these tours -- which are quite expenisve -- that there would be a tour guide on the bus explaining the different areas of Spain that we were traveling through and to give a more extensive history about Seville. title: We were very happy with our driver...
text: We were very happy with our driver, William, and our tour guide, Sylvia. The day was very enjoyable and I would recommend this trip.
author: Cristina L

title: Also a good tour with Michael and...
text: Also a good tour with Michael and Paloma in Seville. She was very good. We asked to go to Plaza Espana and think that should be included routinely.
author: Betty H

title: Great trip! Were picked up at hotel...
text: Great trip! Were picked up at hotel, driver was pleasant, spoke English, gave us travel tips, explained sights en route to Sevilla. When we met up with our tour guide in Sevilla, he was friendly, enthusiastic, and very knowledgeable about the sights and history of Granada. The tour was amazing.
